changes.before:
When $q$ is even the block embedding of $\operatorname{SL}_2(q)$
gives the same normalizers.
changes.after:
When $q>2$ is even the block embedding of $\operatorname{SL}_2(q)$
gives the same normalizers. For $q=2$ the nonsplit construction gives
$D_6$; the trivial split torus gives no rank-two marking.

changes.before: Their dihedral subgroups realize the corresponding smaller orders.
changes.after:
Their dihedral subgroups with rotation order at least two realize the
corresponding smaller orders.
